node.title: Re: writing a utility to determine whether I have a working wifi connection
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext: I tend to use Net::Ping for this sort of thing. The CPAN Testers results say it's highly portable. Of course, you have to choose your ping protocol, and Net::Ping does not support absolutely everything. I tend to use icmp, which requires privilege, at least under a non-Windows system.
